name: fixture-wrong-errno
description: Deliberately wrong on the ABI leg ONLY. The file files.open expects to create already exists in this target's tree, so the kernel itself answers EEXIST where the pinned capture has a success. Nothing edits an observation; the target is genuinely different. It is a SELF-TEST fixture, not a gov-os custody surface: its replay folds the tree each record carried rather than re-deriving a filesystem. The first real record and replay adapters land with the mount at EP-25.

covers_map.note: design/10 §11.4a, declared by the target: what each record kind is ABOUT. The class-named kinds declare "*" — they are appended by the wrapper around the subject call itself, so the act they cover is the act under test and is named in their own payload. The deferred kinds name their act, because their whole point is to land in a later step than the one that caused them.
